cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Acknowledge the Disrespect
cards.instruction: Make someone apologize for the disrespect to your position, not merely for what happened.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Your apology should mention interrupting the chair, not just spilling the tea.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. The trousers hold no office.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: 'Chair.' Let's repair the title while we're here.
